subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: Should the built-in model-facing `write` tool permanently gain the optional `append` contract after the byte-completeness defect is repaired?
rationale: The capability addresses a well-supported silent-data-loss workflow, but adding a durable model-facing filesystem operation and backend contract cannot be authorized from contributor implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Accept append on write
options.body: Keep overwrite as the default and land the optional append parameter after byte-complete sandbox writes and exact-head proof.

options.title: Use a separate append tool
options.body: Keep `write` single-purpose and expose append as a separately allowlistable model tool with its own backend contract.

options.title: Retain overwrite-only behavior
options.body: Decline a new primitive and continue relying on read/edit/write or execution-tool workarounds despite the reported loss mode.

recommendation.title: Accept append on write
recommendation.body: Keep overwrite as the default and land the optional append parameter after byte-complete sandbox writes and exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current write-path mutation and recovery contract that the proposed API extends.
